‘Regular services of reconciliation are essential for Christians.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Christianity in your answer.

Section B – Islam
If you have chosen this section, answer all the questions.
3 (a)

parts.text: Briefly describe what happens during Jummah (Friday mid-day prayer).

parts.text: Briefly describe what it means to say that Muhammad (pbuh) is the Seal of the Prophets.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the significance of the concept of Tawhid (unity of God) for Muslims.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘Understanding akhirah (life after death) helps Muslims in their lives.’
Discuss this statement. Give your own opinion and show that you have thought about other
points of view. You must refer to Islam in your answer. 
‘Wherever you are, Oh Prophet, turn your face towards the sacred mosque.
And wherever you believers are, face towards it so that people will have no argument
against you.’
Surah 2:150
